data.body: Retention decision: reject and revert the RAM-disk experiment. Exact no-RAM control run 31868300174 completed macOS default in 17m28s step wall / 17m26s pytest and the whole macOS job in 20m36s. RAM-disk run 31869753711 completed the same 13,397/65-skipped default in 18m43.77s (about 7.5% slower), then spent 71s measuring/removing and failed on intentionally read-only snapshot trees. Independent organic change 1807 run 31869919362 completed 13,425/65-skipped in 20m54.61s, then spent 98s in the same failed release step. A third organic run 31870391571 completed its RAM-disk default step in 18m26s, still 58s/5.5% slower than control, before entering release. Every observed treatment is slower, none clears the predeclared larger-of-5%-or-variation improvement threshold, and recursive observability/release itself adds material runner occupancy. Per AC7 the experiment must not be retained. Change 1806 is being amended to restore runner.temp and remove the RAM-disk lifecycle and its contract test; selectors, markers, workers, timeouts, platforms, coverage, assertions, collection, and integration coverage remain unchanged.
